title: Senior Associate - Business Operations
description:
About GoKwik

GoKwik is building the growth operating system for D2C and eCommerce brands, enabling businesses to optimise checkout, reduce RTO, power payments, drive retention, and unlock post-purchase engagement. With 15,000+ merchants globally and a growing presence across India, the UK, Europe, and the US, GoKwik is building technology and financial infrastructure that powers the next generation of digital commerce.


Why This Role Matters

As a Senior Associate – Business Operations, you will play a critical role in ensuring a seamless shipping experience for GoKwik’s merchants. You will be responsible for handling shipment-level queries, resolving operational issues, managing support tickets, and coordinating with internal Operations and Account Management teams to ensure timely resolution.
The role requires strong ownership, attention to detail, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced environment where quick and accurate problem-solving directly impacts merchant experience.


What You’ll Own

  • Shipment Query Management: Respond to daily shipment-level queries from merchants across email, ticketing systems, WhatsApp, and calls.
  • Shipment Investigation: Investigate order and shipment status using KwikShip and courier dashboards and provide merchants with clear, accurate, and timely updates.
  • Issue Resolution: Own common shipment-related issues end-to-end, including pickup delays, stuck or misrouted shipments, NDR follow-ups, delivery disputes, lost or damaged parcels, and RTO queries.
  • Internal Coordination: Work closely with Operations and relevant internal teams to investigate and resolve merchant issues within defined timelines.
  • Account Manager Collaboration: Keep Account Managers informed about high-impact, recurring, or account-level issues that may affect merchant relationships.
  • Escalation Management: Identify and escalate issues that could impact SLAs, merchant experience, or business continuity, ensuring all relevant context is provided.
  • Ticket & SLA Management: Own the ticket queue for assigned merchants and ensure first response and resolution are delivered within agreed TATs.
  • Prioritisation: Prioritise issues based on urgency and business impact, particularly during sale events, peak periods, and high-volume business days.
  • Process Improvement: Identify recurring issues and operational bottlenecks and work with relevant teams to improve resolution processes and merchant experience.


Who You Are

  • 2–4 years of experience in Business Operations, Customer Success, Customer Support, Operations, or a similar role.
  • Experience handling customer or merchant queries in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate issues, identify root causes, and drive them to closure.
  • Strong ownership mindset with the ability to independently manage multiple issues and priorities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and calmly during escalations.
  • Comfortable working with dashboards, ticketing systems, and operational data.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accuracy while handling high query volumes.
  • Experience in eCommerce, D2C, logistics, shipping, SaaS, or high-growth startups is a strong plus.


Why GoKwik

At GoKwik, you’ll have the opportunity to work at the intersection of technology, operations, and eCommerce while directly influencing the experience of thousands of merchants. You’ll solve real-time business and operational challenges, work closely with cross-functional teams, and gain deep exposure to the D2C commerce and logistics ecosystem. With a high-ownership culture and a fast-paced environment, this role offers the opportunity to build strong operational expertise while creating measurable impact at scale.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, and internal teams to resolve customer challenges and improve the overall customer experience.
  • Process Excellence: Contribute to customer success processes, documentation, playbooks, and best practices to improve efficiency and customer experience at scale.


Who You Are

  • 1–3 years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Client Servicing, or a similar customer-facing role, preferably in SaaS, D2C, martech, or marketing automation.

  • Exposure to WhatsApp Business APIs, retention marketing, CRM platforms, or automation workflows is a strong plus.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to use data to identify opportunities and make recommendations.

With a high-performance culture, rapid learning opportunities, and the chance to help shape a growing WhatsApp Commerce ecosystem, this role offers a strong platform to build and accelerate your career in Customer Success.

title: Assistant Manager - Partnerships
description:
About GoKwik
GoKwik is a growth operating system designed to power D2C and eCommerce brands from checkout optimisation and reducing return-to-origin (RTO), to payments, retention, and post-purchase engagement. Today, GoKwik enables over 12,000 merchants worldwide, processes around $2 billion in GMV, and is strengthening its AI-powered infrastructure. Backed by RTP Global, Z47, Peak XV, and Think Investments and bolstered by a $13 million growth round in June 2025 (total funding: $68 million), GoKwik is scaling aggressively across India and the UK.

Why This Role Matters
Partnerships fuel GoKwik’s growth engine. Every new integration, every ecosystem collaboration, and every agency tie-up directly impacts our ability to scale merchants faster. As a Assistant Manager - Partnerships, you’ll be at the center of building, nurturing, and scaling our partner ecosystem—whether it’s Shopify agencies, tech enablers, or solution providers. This role isn’t just about relationships, it’s about creating a multiplier effect: every partner you bring in opens doors to dozens of new merchants and opportunities.

What You’ll Own
  • Partner engagement at scale – identify, onboard, and manage agencies, SaaS enablers, and ecosystem players across ecommerce and Shopify
  • Relationship building – cultivate strong day-to-day connections with founders, CXOs, and account managers to unlock joint growth
  • Joint value creation – co-build GTM strategies, execute co-marketing initiatives, and establish lead-sharing mechanisms
  • Partner enablement – ensure partners are trained on GoKwik’s value propositions and equipped with updated product knowledge
  • Performance tracking – monitor partner pipelines, leads generated, and revenue contribution while driving accountability
  • Ecosystem intelligence – stay plugged into the Indian D2C/Shopify ecosystem, mapping agencies and SaaS tools to uncover gaps and opportunities
  • Cross-functional collaboration – align with sales, marketing, and product to ensure partner-led motions translate into revenue

Who You Are
  • 3-5 years of experience in partnerships, business development, or client-facing roles within ecommerce, Shopify, SaaS, or the D2C ecosystem
  • Strong understanding of Shopify agencies, ecommerce enablers, and the Indian D2C landscape
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills with the ability to engage senior stakeholders
  • Analytical mindset—comfortable tracking performance metrics and identifying growth levers
  • Curious, collaborative, and thrives in fast-paced, high-ownership environments
  • (Bonus) Background in a Shopify agency or ecommerce SaaS tool is a plus

Why GoKwik
At GoKwik, we aren’t just building checkout and conversion tools—we’re building the growth fabric for ecommerce in India and beyond. Partnerships are at the core of this mission, helping us plug into the right ecosystems and accelerate adoption across thousands of brands. If you’re excited about shaping the future of ecommerce enablement and want to work at the intersection of strategy, ecosystem building, and growth—this role is for you.

title: Senior Manager - Sales
description:
About GoKwik

GoKwik is a growth operating system designed to power D2C and eCommerce brands across the customer journey. From checkout optimization and payments to retention, engagement, and post-purchase experiences, GoKwik helps brands unlock incremental growth and build stronger, more efficient businesses. With 15,000+ merchants globally and ~$2B in annual GMV processed, GoKwik is building the infrastructure that powers the next generation of commerce.


Why This Role Matters

Ratio is a next-generation storefront solution built for high-growth Indian D2C brands. It helps brands improve their digital storefront experience, site speed, conversion, and revenue per session while providing a more flexible and performance-focused alternative to their existing storefront setup.
As Senior Manager – Sales, you will play a key role in building the market for Ratio. This is an early-stage GTM sales role where you will be responsible for creating demand, identifying high-potential brands, selling a relatively new product, and establishing a repeatable sales motion.
You will work closely with founders and senior eCommerce, Growth, Digital, and Technology leaders to understand their existing storefront and growth challenges, build a compelling business case, and drive strategic opportunities from discovery to closure.


What You’ll Own

New Business & Strategic Revenue

  • Own the revenue target for Ratio and drive new business across high-potential D2C and eCommerce brands.
  • Build and manage a strong pipeline through outbound prospecting, GoKwik’s merchant ecosystem, founder networks, agencies, referrals, and industry relationships.
  • Own the complete sales cycle from prospecting and discovery to product demonstration, negotiation, closure, and onboarding.
  • Identify and develop strategic accounts where storefront, conversion, technology, or performance limitations create a strong opportunity for Ratio.
  • Build accurate forecasts and maintain strong visibility on pipeline, deal stages, risks, and revenue outcomes.

Consultative & Enterprise Selling

  • Engage with founders, CEOs, and senior eCommerce, Growth, Digital, Marketing, and Technology stakeholders.
  • Understand a brand’s storefront, technology stack, traffic profile, conversion funnel, and key growth metrics.
  • Build data-backed business cases around site speed, UX, conversion, revenue/session, AOV, and GMV.
  • Navigate complex, multi-stakeholder sales processes and handle objections around migration, integration, technology risk, existing agencies, Shopify, and internal bandwidth.
  • Position Ratio as a strategic business and technology solution rather than a standalone SaaS product.

GTM & Category Creation

  • Help define Ratio’s ICP, buying triggers, positioning, messaging, and sales process.
  • Build repeatable prospecting, qualification, and closing motions for a new category.
  • Identify recurring customer objections, competitive dynamics, and market opportunities.
  • Work closely with Product, Engineering, Growth, Marketing, and leadership to translate market insights into product and GTM decisions.
  • Develop scalable sales playbooks, customer proof points, POCs, and case studies that strengthen the sales motion.


Who You Are

  • Own retention strategy and execution for 15–30 D2C brands across categories and growth stages
  • Audit and rebuild lifecycle journeys across WhatsApp, Email, and SMS flows

description:
About GoKwik
GoKwik is a growth operating system built for D2C and eCommerce brands, helping merchants maximize growth across the customer journey. From improving checkout conversions and reducing return-to-origin (RTO) to enabling payments, retention, and post-purchase experiences, GoKwik powers over 15,000 merchants globally and processes nearly $2B in GMV annually. Backed by leading global investors, we're building the technology that powers the future of commerce.

Why This Role Matters
As a Manager- Sales, you will be responsible for driving revenue growth across your assigned region by building a high-performing sales team, expanding GoKwik's merchant base, and strengthening relationships with customers and partners. You will play a critical role in executing regional sales strategies, delivering predictable revenue, and identifying new growth opportunities while ensuring operational excellence across the sales function.

What You’ll Own

  • Own the complete sales cycle for Kwik Checkout — from prospecting and discovery to product walkthroughs, solutioning, negotiation, closure, and handover.
  • Drive consultative, discovery-led sales by understanding a merchant’s business, customer journey, checkout experience, and growth objectives.
  • Conduct structured website and checkout audits to identify gaps across conversion, payment experience, prepaid adoption, COD, RTO, customer friction, and overall checkout performance.
  • Translate identified problem statements into data-backed solutioning, clearly demonstrating how Kwik Checkout can create measurable business impact.
  • Deliver compelling product and dashboard walkthroughs, using merchant-specific data, use cases, and insights rather than relying on generic product pitches.
  • Build a strong understanding of the D2C/eCommerce ecosystem, merchant business models, customer behaviour, and the key metrics that influence online growth.
  • Use data, CRM insights, funnel metrics, and merchant performance dashboards to identify opportunities, improve conversion, and build predictability across the sales funnel.
  • Proactively research target merchants, their websites, checkout journeys, tech stack, growth trends, and competitive solutions to create highly relevant sales conversations.
  • Build and manage a healthy pipeline through a combination of inbound leads, outbound prospecting, referrals, and strategic account development.
  • Own revenue targets and maintain strong discipline across pipeline management, forecasting, CRM hygiene, and movement across every stage of the sales funnel.
  • Work closely with Product, Solutions, Partnerships, and Merchant Success teams to ensure the solution proposed is aligned to the merchant’s business requirements and can be successfully implemented.
  • Stay ahead of product developments, industry trends, and competitive offerings and continuously strengthen Kwik Checkout product knowledge.
  • Be AI-forward in the way you work — actively leverage tools such as Claude and other AI-led tools for account research, website analysis, data interpretation, sales preparation, productivity, and building greater predictability in the sales process.
  • Continuously experiment with new approaches, use data to improve sales effectiveness, and leverage technology to work smarter, improve product depth, and accelerate growth.
  • Represent GoKwik confidently in meetings with founders, CXOs, eCommerce leaders, growth teams, and other senior stakeholders.


Who You Are

  • 4–6 years of experience in B2B sales, consultative selling, SaaS, AdTech, MarTech, eCommerce, payments, or the D2C ecosystem.
  • Strong understanding of D2C/eCommerce businesses, digital customer journeys, and online conversion metrics.
  • Someone who genuinely loves products — enjoys understanding how a product works, going deep into its capabilities, and translating features into meaningful business outcomes.
  • Strong in consultative and solution-led selling, with the ability to ask the right questions, uncover the real problem, and build a solution around it.
  • Comfortable analysing a merchant’s website, checkout journey, funnel, and business metrics to identify gaps and formulate actionable solutions.
  • Confident delivering product demos, dashboard walkthroughs, business reviews, and data-led presentations to senior stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to independently manage complex sales cycles and close high-value opportunities with strong ownership.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset, with the ability to use data to identify opportunities and make informed sales decisions.
  • Highly comfortable working with dashboards, CRM platforms, sales analytics, and other data-driven tools.
  • AI-curious and AI-native in approach — someone who actively experiments with tools such as Claude and other AI solutions to improve research, productivity, product understanding, account intelligence, and sales predictability.
  • Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Highly organised, commercially sharp, and disciplined with pipeline management, forecasting, and CRM hygiene.
  • Self-driven and entrepreneurial, with a strong bias for action and the ability to operate independently in a fast-paced startup environment.
  • Willingness to travel for strategic merchant meetings and business requirements.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Sales & Marketing, or a related field preferred.


Why GoKwik
At GoKwik, you'll have the opportunity to shape the growth journey of thousands of D2C brands while working with a high-impact, entrepreneurial team. You'll own meaningful business outcomes, collaborate with experienced leaders, and help build one of India's fastest-growing commerce technology companies. If you're passionate about driving revenue, leading teams, and solving real business challenges at scale, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Associate - Collections & Operations
description:
About GoKwik

GoKwik is building the growth operating system for D2C and eCommerce brands, helping businesses optimise checkout, reduce RTO, enable payments, drive retention, and strengthen post-purchase engagement. With 15,000+ merchants globally and a growing presence across India, the platform combines technology, data, and AI to help brands grow faster and operate better.


Why this role exists

Afford is GoKwik’s Pay-in-Parts product, enabling shoppers to split their purchases into installments at checkout. As the product scales, keeping the book healthy requires a sharp and dependable operations layer that can drive recoveries, hold third-party vendors accountable, maintain strong data hygiene, and turn borrower-level signals into actionable product feedback.
We’re looking for someone who can own the day-to-day collections and operations engine while bringing the discipline to spot patterns, challenge broken processes, and work closely with Risk and Product to improve the overall borrower journey.


What you'll do

Collections & Recovery
  • Call borrowers with overdue installments across the delinquency lifecycle, following defined escalation scripts and tone guidelines.
  • Manage WhatsApp, SMS, and email collections campaigns, track responses, follow up with non-responders, and accurately log outcomes.
  • Maintain detailed call, payment-promise, and recovery records across collections trackers and dashboards.
  • Work towards improving connect rates and promise-to-pay conversion across assigned cohorts.
Vendor & Operations Management
  • Coordinate with third-party collection vendors to ensure campaigns run on schedule and processes are followed.
  • Monitor vendor data hygiene and identify issues such as stale “stop calling” flags, incorrect contact lists, or delayed status updates.
  • Reconcile vendor reports with internal data, chase discrepancies, and ensure timely resolution.
  • Own day-to-day operational hygiene and proactively escalate blockers or recurring issues.
Insights & Feedback
  • Track borrower behaviour across cohorts, channels, payment responses, and communication approaches.
  • Identify where scripts, channels, or processes are not working and bring data-backed insights to the Risk and Product teams.
  • Work with Risk and Product to improve communication templates, escalation timing, and campaign strategy.
  • Support experiments such as copy refreshes, alternate-number targeting, and cohort-based tone or channel testing.
  • Bring real borrower feedback into product and process improvements.


Who you are

  • 2–4 years of experience in Fintech, NBFC, Insurance sales/collections, customer operations, or a similar customer-facing environment.
  • Comfortable with Excel, including pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and basic formulas. You should be able to take a raw data dump and independently slice and analyse it.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to have calm, professional, and firm conversations with borrowers.
  • Able to write clear WhatsApp, SMS, and email nudges that drive responses.
  • Process-minded: you follow SOPs and escalation matrices carefully, but also flag when a process is not working.
  • Comfortable managing third-party vendors and holding them accountable for execution and data quality.
  • Strong attention to detail and ownership of operational accuracy.
  • Data-oriented and curious about understanding the “why” behind borrower behaviour.


Why GoKwik

You’ll sit close to both the borrower experience and the product roadmap. This is a rare opportunity to work beyond traditional collections — your day-to-day recovery conversations, operational observations, and borrower insights will directly influence what the Risk and Product teams build next.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
About GoKwik

GoKwik is a growth operating system designed to power D2C and eCommerce brands—from checkout optimization and reducing return-to-origin (RTO), to payments, retention, and post-purchase engagement. Today, GoKwik enables 15,000+ merchants globally, processes around $2B in GMV, and continues to strengthen its AI-powered infrastructure. As we expand our product ecosystem, we're investing in a robust platform foundation that enables faster innovation, greater scalability, and seamless experiences across all our products.


Why This Role Matters

As the Senior Product Manager- Platform, you will define and lead the strategy for the shared platform that powers GoKwik's entire product ecosystem. This is a high-impact leadership role responsible for building reusable platform capabilities that accelerate product development, improve reliability, and ensure consistency across merchant experiences.
Working closely with Product, Engineering, Data, AI, Security, and Business leaders, you will drive platform adoption, establish governance, and shape the long-term technical foundation that enables GoKwik to scale efficiently across products, merchants, and commerce platforms.


What You'll Own

Platform Strategy & Vision

  • Define the long-term vision, roadmap, and priorities for GoKwik's platform ecosystem.
  • Build reusable platform capabilities that enable multiple product teams to innovate faster.
  • Balance short-term business priorities with long-term platform investments and technical scalability.

Shared Platform Capabilities

  • Own shared services, APIs, data contracts, common workflows, and reusable platform components.
  • Drive platform standardization across authentication, data models, integrations, infrastructure, and developer tooling.
  • Ensure platform capabilities support multiple merchant environments, including Shopify, custom storefronts, and other eCommerce platforms.

Cross-Functional Product Leadership

  • Partner with Product leaders to ensure new features are designed for extensibility, reusability, and multi-platform compatibility.
  • Review product requirements and technical designs to ensure alignment with platform standards.
  • Make strategic decisions on what should become shared platform capabilities versus product-specific implementations.

Platform Governance & Adoption

  • Drive adoption of shared services, APIs, and reusable components across engineering and product teams.
  • Reduce duplicate systems, fragmented implementations, and one-off product builds.
  • Establish governance processes around platform standards, architecture reviews, migration plans, and exception management.
  • Define and monitor platform success metrics across adoption, reliability, migration progress, platform velocity, and internal customer satisfaction.

Platform Execution & Delivery

  • Own visibility into platform migrations, dependencies, milestones, risks, and execution plans.
  • Partner with Engineering leaders on architecture, scalability, reliability, observability, deployment strategies, and platform SLAs.
  • Collaborate with Data Engineering, BI, AI, Security, Compliance, and Legal teams to embed governance, privacy, consent, and regulatory requirements into platform design.
  • Improve internal developer experience through better documentation, discoverability, onboarding, and platform usability.
  • Lead cross-functional operating cadences, including roadmap reviews, design reviews, adoption reviews, and stakeholder communication.


Who You Are

  • 5-8 years of product management experience, with 2-3 years leading platform products or technically complex product areas.
  • Proven experience building platform products within B2B SaaS, fintech, commerce infrastructure, payments, developer platforms, API platforms, data platforms, or shared-services environments.
  • Strong technical product expertise across APIs, distributed systems, platform architecture, data flows, scalability, reliability, and platform trade-offs.
  • Comfortable partnering with senior Engineering leaders and contributing meaningfully to architecture and technical design discussions.
  • Experienced in driving platform adoption across multiple product and engineering teams without direct authority.
  • Strong product judgment with the ability to balance business priorities, platform investments, compliance, and engineering constraints.
  • Excellent executive communication, stakeholder management, and decision-making skills.
  • Thrives in high-growth, fast-paced environments with significant ownership and ambiguity.
  • Thinks in systems, reusable capabilities, service boundaries, governance, and long-term leverage rather than individual product features.
  • Comfortable challenging architectural decisions while maintaining strong partnerships with engineering teams.
  • Operates as both a strategic product leader and a hands-on execution owner for complex, cross-functional initiatives.


Why GoKwik

At GoKwik, you'll shape the platform that powers every product we build. This role offers the opportunity to influence company-wide architecture, accelerate innovation across multiple product lines, and build scalable technology that serves thousands of merchants globally. If you're passionate about platform thinking, solving complex systems problems, and enabling teams to move faster through great infrastructure and product design, you'll have the autonomy, ownership, and impact to define the next phase of GoKwik's platform journey.

title: Lead DevSecOps Engineer
description:
About GoKwik
GoKwik is a growth operating system designed to power D2C and eCommerce brands from checkout optimisation and reducing return-to-origin (RTO), to payments, retention, and post-purchase engagement. Today, GoKwik enables over 15,000+ merchants worldwide, processes around $2 billion in GMV, and is strengthening its AI-powered infrastructure. Backed by RTP Global, Z47, Peak XV, and Think Investments and bolstered by a $13 million growth round in June 2025 (total funding: $68 million), GoKwik is scaling aggressively across India and the UK.

Why This Role Matters
At GoKwik, Security isn’t a bolt-on, it’s a core part of how we build, ship, and scale. As a Lead DevSecOps Engineer, you’ll ensure every layer of our infrastructure and development lifecycle is secure, compliant, and resilient. You’ll work end-to-end with Engineering teams, from design and deployment using agentic platforms to operations and optimisation, embedding security guardrails into CI/CD pipelines, automating IAM and compliance checks, and reducing human error to near zero. You’ll also shape a culture where security is a shared responsibility, not a last-minute review, while staying battle-ready with AI first thinking to lead incident response and drive blameless learning. In short, you’ll own the frameworks and practices that let GoKwik grow fast without ever compromising trust, directly protecting $2B+ GMV and thousands of merchants who rely on us every day.


What You'll Own
  • Build secure CI/CD pipelines by embedding vulnerability scanning, SAST, and DAST, ensuring every release ships fast and safe.
  • Partner with engineering and security teams to design cloud-native architectures that are secure by default and resilient at scale.
  • Automate the boring stuff, from secrets management and IAM policy enforcement to compliance validation checks, cutting down human error and accelerating delivery.
  • Integrate best-in-class security tools (Vault, Prisma, Aqua, Trivy, etc.) into every layer of our infrastructure
  • Take the lead during security incidents, coordinating response across teams and ensuring issues are remediated quickly and effectively.
  • Drive a proactive DevSecOps culture by running training, awareness programs, and blameless postmortems that turn incidents into learnings.
  • Own compliance readiness (SOC2, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS), working closely with governance and legal to keep us always audit-prepared without slowing down engineering.


Who You Are
  • 8-12 years of hands-on and leading experience in DevSecOps or Cloud Security Engineering within fast-scaling SaaS or eCommerce environments.
  • Exposure to AI/LLM security frameworks and modern AI risk models.
  • Strong grasp of AppSec and Cloud Security fundamentals, from IAM, WAF, and KMS to CSPM best practices.
  • Practical experience with Kubernetes security (RBAC, PodSecurity, NetworkPolicies) and keeping clusters production-hardened.
  • Comfortable with threat modelling, incident response, and security compliance frameworks (ISO, SOC2, PCI-DSS).
  • Solid coding/scripting skills (Python, Go, Bash, etc.) to automate controls and eliminate repetitive manual work.
  • Someone who doesn’t just know the theory but has battle-tested experience in securing systems at scale.

Why GoKwik
At GoKwik, we aren’t just building tools, we’re rewriting the playbook for eCommerce in India. We exist to solve some of the most complex challenges faced by digital-first brands: low conversion rates, high RTO, and poor post-purchase experience. Our checkout and conversion stack powers 500+ leading D2C brands and marketplaces and we’re just getting started.
